name: manual_9d92e2
claim: Keep operator billing attestation, independent launcher review, installed CLI capabilities, and enforced wire-level budget limits as separate dispatch gates.

decisions.notes: In the Portal round a Cline-WandB command was reported to reject the cap flags; the time-limited fallback was not equivalent. Console output and provider usage observed after generation do not prove admission-time enforcement. Do not treat approval as a substitute for verified technical bounds or silently switch providers.
